keep: Original character face, hair, named identity elements, existing color palette
Casual, comfortable mood and production-friendly color area count
change: Move hem upward relative to skirt waist without adding another shirt layer
Rebalance wide sleeve/body volume against the skirt opening at front and back
forbid: New stripes, piping, belts, patches, charms, decorative trims
Info graphic text, comparison tables or report layouts in final character art
